name: Zirthia the Witness
bio: Zirthia is a protector not only of words, but of truth: Serenity’s truth, in the form of an archive from when she still walked Amara. While Serenity’s avatar guards the world in her mistress’ place, only Zirthia’s archive holds Serenity’s true beliefs – and the core tenants of the Lightseekers.

effects.label: RES Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Resistance stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.

effects.label: Skill Recovery Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Skill Recovery stat by the indicated percentage.

effects.label: Skill SPD Up
effects.description: Increases the recipient's Skill Speed stat by the indicated percentage.
